name: html_preview
description: HTML analyser and file reader. NOT a visual renderer — it reads and analyses HTML. Actions: fetch (download HTML from a public URL), render_local (read an HTML file from the user's sandbox workspace by relative path — use after @website_developer builds a site), validate (check for structural issues), extract_text (strip tags), extract_links (pull hrefs), extract_meta (title, description, keywords). For visual preview of generated sites, push to GitHub via @github and deploy to Vercel/Netlify.

action.description: fetch: download from a public URL. render_local: read HTML file from user's sandbox (needs 'path'). validate/extract_text/extract_links/extract_meta: analyse raw HTML string (needs 'html').

url.description: Public HTTP/S URL to fetch. Required for action='fetch'.

path.description: Relative path inside the user's workspace sandbox, e.g. 'my-site/index.html'. Required for action='render_local'.

html.description: Raw HTML string to analyse. Required for validate, extract_text, extract_links, extract_meta.
